title: [Feature Request]: Make workflow visualizer work for FunctionAgent and AgentWorkflow-like agents
body:
### Feature Description

It would be great to have the agent visualizer also work with tools/agent hand offs. So far it's designed to only show workflow steps and events. But, a lot of the time I'm seeing people use the pre-made agents like the AgentWorkflow and the FunctionAgent. It would be super cool if we can also show the tools that an agent has access to/agent hand-offs available etc.

linked_prs.title: Adding visualization functions for single/multi agent workflows
linked_prs.body:
# Description

With this PR, we add two new functions to draw single/multi agent workflows like we do for `Workflow`.

Fixes #19080

Example usage:

```python
from llama_index.utils.workflow import draw_agent_with_tools, draw_agent_workflow

def add(i,j):
    """Add two numbers together"""
    return i+j

def subtract(i,j):
    """Subtract two numbers from each other"""
    return i-j

def multiply(i,j):
    """Multiply two numbers together"""
    return i*j

tools = [FunctionTool.from_defaults(add)]
tools1= [multiply, subtract]

def execute_code(code):
    print(code)

agent = CodeActAgent(code_execute_fn=execute_code, name="CodeAgent", tools=tools, llm = MockLLM(), can_handoff_to=["ReactAgent"], description="Some agent")
agent1 = ReActAgent(tools=tools1, name="ReactAgent", llm=MockLLM(), description="Some other agent")
agent_wf = AgentWorkflow(agents=[agent, agent1], root_agent=agent.name)
draw_agent_with_tools(agent)
draw_agent_with_tools(agent1)
draw_agent_workflow(agent_wf)
```

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it requests a feature for visualizing workflows specific to agent systems (FunctionAgent, AgentWorkflow), including tool access and agent hand-offs—core agent behaviors per the taxonomy (Workflow issues, Tool-related issues).
